tyler (AE): heads-up — FinTech POC wants to iterate locally w/ hosted API keys, but wants dedicated pool for perf tests and VPC for security gating. Need least-privilege invites for 6 devs. Any quick plan?

maria (SE): ok. propose 2 workspaces: hosted-sandbox for dev + dedicated-pool for load. We'll issue ephemeral keys for devs (30m) and full dev role on hosted only. Dedicated pool access behind role 'pool-operator' + SSO. Thoughts?

sam (CloudEng): +1. For private/VPC: ask customer for allowed CIDR and whether they want VPC peering or private endpoint. We can do VPC endpoints — requires subnet + route table config.

maria (SE): sample ephemeral key curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/ephemeral -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" -d '{"ttl":1800,"scopes":["inference:hosted"]}'
```
Give devs scope-only for hosted, not dedicated.

lisa (CSM): pricing note: dedicated pool sizing will change quote. For perf test we recommend 2x capacity for ramp; rough incremental is ~$X/hr per GPU. I'll open a pricing thread with finance.

julian (Security): checklist for questionnaires: SOC2 status, KMS integration (we support customer KMS via Private), data residency options, audit logs retention, RBAC roles mapping to SAML groups. Also need details on encryption in transit for VPC endpoints.

tyler (AE): customer asked for least-privilege invite steps — can you drop a minimal RBAC mapping I can send?

maria (SE): minimal RBAC mapping:
- role: viewer -> read-only on workspace
- role: dev_hosted -> create/invoke hosted keys, no pool access
- role: pool_operator -> deploy to dedicated pools, manage scaling
- role: admin -> full
We'll add SAML group mapping: devs -> dev_hosted, infra -> pool_operator.

workspace-bot: invite link created — https://redwood.workspaces/join/abc123 (expires in 7d)

sam (CloudEng): note on provisioning flow: 1) create hosted sandbox + ephemeral keys 2) run perf on hosted 3) provision dedicated pool (reserve) 4) create VPC endpoints 5) flip SSO group to pool_operator for perf team

tyler (AE): perfect. I'll send to customer and request CIDR + SAML metadata. tagging @lisa for pricing follow-up. :thumbsup:
